title: Circular Motion in Speed, Time and Distance (Level 3)

questions.q_en: A and B start jogging on a 220m circular track. They begin at the same time and from the same point but jog in opposite directions, one at 22⁄3 m/s and the other at 21⁄3 m/s. The number of times they meet during the first 11 minutes is?
questions.solution_en:
Time taken by them to meet for the first time =

= (220*3)/15 = 44 sec

Therefore, number of times they'll meet in first 11mins = 11 * 60 sec = 660/44 = 15

questions.q_en: Adam Goldberg and Barry Goldberg have decided on one day to go for race of 3 km on a 200m circular track. If Adam Goldberg's speed is 1.5 times Barry Goldberg's speed, how many times will they meet each other in the circular track?
questions.solution_en:
Given, Adam's speed is 1.5 times Barry's speed.

=> When Adam covers 3 m, Barry covers 2 m.

=> When Adam covers 3 m, Adam gains 1 m over Barry.

=> When Adam covers 3 * 200 = 600 m, Adam gains 200 m over Barry.

=> When Adam covers 600 m, Adam passes Barry 1 time.

=> When Adam covers 3000 m, Adam passes Barry = 3000/600 = 5 times.

questions.q_en: Three persons A, B and C start running around a circular stadium and complete a single round in 5 sec, (X - 3) sec and (X - 1) sec respectively. After 315 sec, they meet again at the starting point for the first time. Find the time taken by B to complete a single round of stadium.
questions.solution_en:
We know that the time at which they met again is equal to the LCM of 5, (X - 3) and (X - 1).

SO,

5* (X - 3)* (X - 1) = 315

X2 - 4X + 3 = 63

X2 - 4X - 60 = 0

X2 - 10X + 6X - 60 = 0

(X - 10) (X + 6) = 0

X = 10 or -6

X = -6 is not possible.

SO, X = 10

Therefore, time taken by B to complete one single round of stadium = (10 - 3) = 7 sec.

questions.q_en: In a circular field points A and B are diametrically opposite. Rahul takes 14 minutes to go to B from A. If area of the circular field is 0.385 km2, then what will be the approximate difference between speed of Rahul and speed of Mukesh if he takes same time to go to B from A along the perimeter of the field as the time taken by Rahul?
questions.solution_en:
Let radius of field = 'R'

Area of field = (22/7) * R2 = 0.385

R2 = 0.1225

R = 0.35 km = 350 m

Total distance covered by Rahul = 2R = 700 m

Speed of Rahul = 700/14

Total distance covered by Mukesh = (22/7) * 350 = 1100 m

Speed of Mukesh = 1100/14

Required difference = (1100/14) - (700/14) = (200/7) m/min

questions.q_en: A, B, and C run simultaneously starting from a point around a circular track of length of 600 m at respective speeds of 6 m/s, 8 m/s, and 11 m/s. A and B run in the same direction while C runs in the opposite direction to the other two. After how much time will they meet for the first time?
questions.solution_en:
Relative speed of A and C = 6 + 11 = 17 m/sec

Relative speed of B and C = 8 + 11 = 19 m/sec

Net speed = 19 - 17 = 2 m/sec

Time taken by them to meet for the first time = 600/2 = 300 sec = 5 min
questions.solution_hi:

questions.q_en: Two runners, Abhi and Pihu start running on a circular track of length 210 m at speeds of 18 and 21 kmph, respectively, in the same direction. After how much time from the start will they meet again at the starting point?
questions.solution_en:
Time taken by Abhi to complete 210 m = 210/ (18 x 5/18) = 42 sec

Time taken by Pihu to complete 210 m = 210/ (21 x 5/18) = 36 sec

Required time = LCM of 42 and 36 = 252 seconds

questions.q_en: In a race around a circular track of 80 km, two cyclists are riding at a speed of 32 kmph and 16 kmph. After what time (in hours) will they meet at the point from where they started their journey?
questions.solution_en:
Time taken by one cyclist = 80/32 hours

Time taken by other cyclist = 80/16 hours

Required time = LCM of (80/32) and (80/16)

= LCM of (5/2) and 5

= 5

questions.q_en: Two friends A and B simultaneously start running from same point around a circular track. They run in the same direction. A runs at 9 kmph and B runs at X kmph. If they cross each other at exactly two points on the circular track, then find the value of X.
questions.solution_en:
Ratio of the speeds = 9: X

When the runners are running in the same direction, the number of points where they cross other exactly = difference between the numeric digits of their speed ratio.

Here,

9 - X = 2

X = 7 kmph.

questions.q_en: On a circular path of 595 m, Anil and Billa start walking from the same point but in the opposite direction at the speed of 3.45 km/h and 2.5 km/h, respectively. When they will meet for the first time?
questions.solution_en:
Relative speed = 3.45 + 2.5 = 5.95 kmph

Required time = (595/1000)/5.95

= 1/10 hours

= After 6 minutes

questions.q_en: M, N, and O run simultaneously, starting from a point, around a circular track of length 1600 m, at respective speeds of 3 m/s, 7 m/s, and 11 m/s. M and N run in the same direction, while O runs in the opposite direction to the other two. After how much time will they meet for the first time?
questions.solution_en:
Relative speed of M and O = 11 + 3 = 14 m/s

Relative speed of N and O = 11 + 7 = 18 m/s

Net relative speed = 18 - 14 = 4 m/s

Time taken by them to meet for the first time = 1600/4 = 400 sec = 6 minutes 40 seconds

questions.q_en: Nishu and Mohan run a race of 20 km on a circular track of length 900 m. Both complete one round in 180 sec and 240 sec, respectively. After how much time from the start will the Nishu meet Mohan for the last time?
questions.solution_en:
Time taken by Nishu to complete 20 km or 20000 m = (180/900) x 20000 = 4000 sec

So, the required answer will be less than 4000 sec.

Speed of Nishu = 900/180 = 5 m/sec

Speed of Mohan = 900/240 = 3.75 m/sec

Relative speed = 5 - 3.75 = 1.25 m/sec

Time taken by them to meet first time at the track anywhere = 900/1.25 = 720 sec

So, the required answer will be the multiple of 720 that is close to 4000, and that is 3600.

Therefore, after 3600 sec from the start Nishu meet Mohan for the last time.

questions.q_en: Bike A and bike B run a race of 80 km on a circular track of length 1200 m. Both complete one round in 300 sec and 360 sec, respectively. After how much time from the start will the Bike A meet Bike B for the last time?
questions.solution_en:
Time taken by Bike A to complete 80 km or 80000 m = (300/1200) x 80000 = 20000 sec

So, the required answer will be less than 20000 sec.

Speed of Bike A = 1200/300 = 4 m/sec

Speed of Bike B = 1200/360 = 10/3 m/sec

Relative speed = 4 - (10/3) = 2/3 m/sec

Time taken by them to meet first time at the track anywhere = 1200/ (2/3) = 1800 sec

So, the required answer will be the multiple of 1800 that is close to 20000, and that is 19800.

Therefore, after 19800 sec or 5.5 hours from the start Bike A meet Bike B for the last time.

questions.q_en: Two persons started running on a circular track simultaneously with speeds of 24 m/s and 36 m/sec in opposite directions. If the circumference of the circular track is 120 m, then find at how many distinct points they will cross each other?
questions.solution_en:
Time taken by them to meet first time anywhere at the track = 120/ (24 + 36) = 2 sec

Time taken by them to meet first time at the starting point = LCM of (120/24) and (120/36)

= LCM of 5 and (10/3)

= 10

Number of distinct points they will cross each other = Time taken by them to meet first time at the starting point/Time taken by them to meet first time anywhere at the track

= 10/2

= 5
questions.solution_hi:

= 10
